verdict.rationale: SES documents account-level tracking of bounce, complaint and reject rates. Its Virtual Deliverability Manager adds deliverability insights, inbox-placement improvement and recommendations it can apply automatically, which goes beyond raw counts. Event publishing to CloudWatch, Firehose and others supports further analysis, though older community posts say delivery reports had to be built yourself, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of engagement (open/click) analytics dashboards, in-depth docs on how VDM's reputation and inbox-placement guidance works, independent hands-on corroboration of VDM insights.
